mentions.name: To Learn Japanese
mentions.description: A gamified web app for learning Japanese Hiragana that gradually introduces characters. It takes elements from Anki and other language learning apps but stays focused so it fits well into a broader language learning journey, with the goal of making learning Japanese more fun. The creator, currently in Osaka, uses the app himself.
mentions.problem: Hopes to make learning Japanese more fun
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on an app to learn Hiragana.

A gamified approach that gradually introduces characters.

As I'm currently in Osaka I can use my own app well :) Hoping to make learning Japanese more fun.

It's here: https://app.tolearnjapanese.com
